One. How are they getting to the castle?
Girl: Is the tram still delayed?
Boy: Yes. We are taking the bus, not walking.

Two. Where will the girl meet her cousin?
Boy: Are you meeting at the station?
Girl: No, she is meeting me at the library, not the cafe.

Three. What time does the boat leave?
Girl: I thought the boat left at ten.
Boy: That is the weekday time. On Sunday it leaves at eleven. We must arrive before then.

Four. What is the boy putting in his bag?
Girl: Have you got your camera?
Boy: Mum has it. I am putting the map in my bag. The tickets are in her pocket.

Five. Which way should they go?
Boy: Do we turn left at the crossing?
Girl: No, go straight on. Do not turn right either.
